name: clanker-spanker
shortDescription: macOS desktop app that monitors GitHub pull requests and automatically fixes CI failures and code-review comments using Claude.
description: clanker-spanker is a Tauri-based macOS desktop app that watches your GitHub PRs and automatically resolves blockers — CI failures, code-review comments, requested changes — by dispatching Claude with a curated context window for each PR. Reduces the manual round-trip between 'PR opened' and 'PR mergeable'.
